title: realized_calibration crashed on AppleDouble (._*) or non-UTF-8 pick files and the health runner silently swallowed the crash
tier_reason: a model-quality health check could go silently blind; no delivery, state or liveness effect, and both links are fixed

contract.text: Health checks skip non-pick files in the picks directory, and a check that raises is surfaced to the operator rather than silently returning no alerts.
contract.source: commit 52db4d7 body; commit 0f2bc3c body ('a crashing check is itself surfaced as a CRITICAL'); docs/audit/2026-06-09-fable5-full-audit.md P1 'Crashed health check returns [] - dead smoke detector'

mechanism.text: realized_calibration read every *.json in the picks directory and caught only JSONDecodeError/OSError, so a macOS AppleDouble sidecar (._<date>.json, binary) or any non-UTF-8 file raised UnicodeDecodeError out of the check
the health runner's _safe_run logged any check exception and returned [], so a crashing check produced no alert and no DM

watchdog.trigger: monitor-internal failure (a health check that raises); no service boundary - covered since 0f2bc3c by the runner surfacing a crashed check as CRITICAL

evidence.what: adds `if f.name.startswith('._'): continue` and UnicodeDecodeError to the caught exceptions; the new test writes a binary ._2026-04-28.json and a non-UTF-8 file
deploy of head 52db4d7 created 2026-05-09T03:46:03Z (5/08 23:46 ET), conclusion success; the backfill memo calls it 'a later narrow health hotfix'
first successful deploy whose head (279d423) contains 0f2bc3c, created 2026-06-10T14:35:51Z; log bound live by 2026-07-02T15:28:10Z (run 28601525167)
the frozen W0.7 picks tree held 14 AppleDouble ._* files (appledouble_resource_fork), so such files did reach the production picks directory at some point; their creation dates are not stated

notes: prelim OI?/B; no located artifact says the crash happened live (52db4d7's body describes the fix only), so drafted deployed_latent_defect; if B1 file metadata dates any of the 14 ._* files before 5/09, the check was silently blind from then - upgrade to observed/unresolved
the 52db4d7 timing (13 min after the 5/08 23:32 ET shadow backfill apply, which used a picks snapshot copied to a Mac) suggests the ._ files arrived with that work - I'm guessing
matters to watchdog coverage only through link 2 (a silently dead monitor), which the Fable-5 audit fixed as H3 (0f2bc3c, part of E59 / I-059)
